attack_patterns.name: Windows Management Instrumentation
attack_patterns.description: Altair ransomware uses WMI to gather system information, control processes, and execute commands to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Altair ransomware exfiltrates sensitive files from the victim's network to an attacker-controlled server before encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Altair ransomware encrypts user files on a compromised system and appends a variant-specific extension like .altair19.

malware.name: Altair
malware.description: A new ransomware strain targeting Windows systems that employs a double-extortion model. It encrypts files with an extension like '.altair19', exfiltrates data, and drops an HTML ransom note named RANSOM_NOTE.html.

tools.name: wmic.exe
tools.description: The Altair ransomware uses wmic.exe, the WMI command-line utility, for stealthy reconnaissance and execution of commands.

infrastructure.name: Altair Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: A server controlled by the Altair operators to which sensitive victim data is exfiltrated before encryption.

infrastructure.name: Altair Tor Contact Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The Tor network is used as a contact method for victims to communicate with the Altair ransomware operators, as instructed in the ransom note.

indicators.name: Altair Ransom Note File Detection
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Altair Ransomware Note Creation
id: 27a9b1c0-3d4e-4f5a-8b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the Altair ransom note file 'RANSOM_NOTE.html'.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-25-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-28
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\RANSOM_NOTE.html'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Altair Encrypted File Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Altair Ransomware Encrypted File
id: 8f9a0b1c-2d3e-4f5a-8b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2d
status: experimental
description: Detects files encrypted by Altair ransomware, which are appended with the '.altair19' extension.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-25-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-28
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.altair19'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Suspicious WMI Process Creation by WMIC
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Process Creation via WMIC
id: 5e6f7a8b-9c0d-4e1f-8a2b-3c4d5e6f7a8b
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'wmic.exe' to create new processes, a technique used by Altair ransomware for execution.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-25-sep-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-28
tags:
  - attack.t1047
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'process call create'
  condition: selection
